samples.summary: New batch-seam mechanics (read routing via `readRoot`, model-layer `Doc.batch` cache invariant) are not reflected in the design docs or the driving task doc, which still describe the seam as write-only routing and explicitly record the opposite read decision.
samples.evidence: `docs-collaboration.md:272-279` and `docs-font-controls.md:370-382` describe the seam as "one top-level batch opens exactly one `doc.update` (an ambient root ... with every **write** routed through `withUpdate`)" — no mention of a read seam. The driving task doc `docs/tasks/active/20260829-docs-store-batch-seam-todo.md:56-59` explicitly records the confirmed SDK semantics as "`Document.getRoot()` ... builds a fresh context over the *same* `clone.root` the open update is mutating, so reads inside a batch observe in-progress writes ... the store only reads there", and its Plan/Review sections are all checked off with no entry for `readRoot` or for `Doc.batch`. This delta adds `YorkieDocStore.readRoot()` (yorkie-doc-store.ts, routing 7 read sites through the ambient root) and `Doc.batch()` (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:146, a new model-layer invariant that the cached `_document` is re-read when a batch rolls back). Neither the canonical subsystem docs nor the task doc were updated, so the recorded design now contradicts the shipped code. Per CONTRIBUTING/design-doc discipline these belong folded into `docs-collaboration.md`'s Undo/Redo section, not left undocumented. Behavior still works as specified, hence minor.

samples.summary: Two overlapping batch seams now exist (`DocStore.batch` and `Doc.batch`) with nothing steering callers to the safe one; the cache-consistency invariant the delta introduces is convention-only.
samples.evidence: `Doc.batch` (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:146) exists solely to re-read `_document` when the store rolls a batch back, and `withNamedStyleChange` was moved onto it (view/editor.ts:1087). But `DocStore.batch` remains public and equally reachable from the editor, which holds both `docStore` and `doc`; its interface docblock (store.ts:62-76) documents the rollback caveat but never says "if a `Doc` cache is live over this store, call `Doc.batch` instead". Any future batched path that calls `docStore.batch` directly re-creates exactly the stale-cache hazard this delta was written to remove, with no lint, type, or test to catch it. Wrong-layer/discoverability cost stays inside the codebase, so minor.
